## 1. Literal map and static-source subtraction

The carrier is F_q^N for a genuine prime power q=p^e, e≥1, N≥0.
Every factor 1-a_d x^d is a unit modulo x^(N+1), so its truncated inverse
exists without division by an integer or selection of an integer lift.
The empty vector is a singleton fixed state.

For a positive degree k, factor expansion is indexed by the nonnegative
multiplicities with sum d r_d=k. The only term involving a_k is a_k itself.
Thus b_k=a_k+P_k(a_1,...,a_(k-1)) and b_1=a_1. Recursive subtraction gives
one predecessor for every target. Every iterate is a bijection, including
time zero, and finiteness makes the entire carrier recurrent with depth zero.

Lenstra's exact finite version of Lemma 5 already identifies this static
product-coordinate bijection with the group of truncated unit series.
The feedback map additionally identifies output coefficients with the next
input coordinates. Nothing in the inspected lemma says that Lenstra
classified iteration under that identification.
[Lenstra, Lemma 5](https://math.berkeley.edu/~hwl/papers/witt.pdf)

The old ELD proof's first step gives the same recursive factorization.
Old USS spends the same lower-triangular inversion and singleton-fibre
mechanism. This supports subtracting the mechanism without falsely asserting
that all three literal dynamical systems coincide.

The ordinary integer-exponent Euler transform has factors
(1-x^d)^(-a_d), not (1-a_d x^d)^(-1). Over an extension field, interpreting
the former exponent already needs extra structure; no such convention is
part of this submitted map. The distinction is correctly maintained.

## 2. Generic period bound and exact fixed locus

The triangular induction is valid over every specified field F_q.
Suppose the first k-1 coordinates have returned after M=p^(k-2) updates.
Their entire M-step lower-coordinate sequence then repeats independently
of the starting kth coordinate. The kth coordinate receives the same total
increment C in each block. After p blocks it receives pC=0, proving that
the first k coordinates return after p^(k-1) steps.

At k=N this gives T_N^(p^(N-1))=id for N≥1. Each strict period divides an
identity exponent and therefore is a power of p. N=1 is identity; N=0 is
handled separately. This induction gives a coarse general triangular bound,
not its attainability, the exact order, individual cycles or their census.

For a nonzero tuple let m be its least nonzero index. If 2m≤N, the degree
2m coefficient can only receive a_(2m) and a_m^2: any smaller nonzero
contributing index is impossible, and three selections exceed degree 2m.
There is one geometric-series term a_m^2, not a combinatorial factor two.
Hence no characteristic-two cancellation invalidates the argument.
A field has no nonzero square-zero element, so this coordinate changes.

Conversely, when a_1 through a_floor(N/2) vanish, every product or repeated
selection of two remaining positive degrees exceeds the truncation degree.
Only the single-index linear terms remain, and the tuple is fixed.
Consequently the fixed locus and count q^ceil(N/2) are correct, including
N=0 and N=1. The stated field assumption cannot silently be replaced by an
arbitrary ring with nilpotents.

The exact fixed locus is a valid property of this recurrent map, but it does
not supply the required materially different inverse/fibre/extremal mechanism
after the static bijection and singleton fibres are removed.

## 3. Old controls are used at their actual strength

At p=2 and old ELD truncation x^3, its literal logarithmic-derivative update
sends (a_1,a_2) to (a_1,a_1). It has two image states; the new triangular
T_2 has four. This proves nonconjugacy in that exact finite control.
It does not establish an all-parameter separation or exclude other factors.

At p=2, N=3 and f=1+x, old USS produces 1+x+x^2, while the feedback product
produces 1+x+x^2+x^3 modulo x^4. This is a correct one-input literal
inequality, not a proof of nonconjugacy. The source and report consistently
keep those two logical strengths apart.

These controls were checked by hand from the actual old literals. No old
pilot, paper-local verifier, scientific code or finite box was executed.

## 4. Side source lead: exact full-carrier obstruction only

The primary formula uses a determinant denominator between the two neighboring
frame vectors, while the proposed finite carrier only requires adjacent
determinants to be nonzero. The cyclic composition starts with vertex 1.
Those are precisely the inspected formula and schedule.
[Arnold–Fuchs–Tabachnikov, formula (9) and section 3.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2112.08124v1)

For the submitted F5 tuple
P_1=(0,1), P_2=(2,0), P_3=(0,2), P_4=(1,0),
the four adjacent determinants are 3,4,3,1, so the tuple is in the declared
carrier. The first recut uses A=P_4 and B=P_2=2A. Their determinant is zero,
but its numerator is A-2B=(-3,0)=(2,0), not zero.
Thus the source formula is undefined at this state before the sweep proceeds.

There is also no linear interchange of these two collinear frame vectors:
R(A)=2A would force R(2A)=4A, contradicting R(B)=A.
This is an exact obstruction at the displayed state, not a division
cancellation, rounding convention or exceptional state silently omitted.

The result excludes importing this source formula as a total update on this
whole adjacent-nondegenerate F5 carrier. It does not rule out every regular
invariant finite subcarrier, and it introduces no totalization, sink or skip.
On a separately supplied subcarrier preserved by everywhere-defined elementary
involutions, reverse-order composition would give an inverse; that conditional
generic observation is not an independent contribution axis.

The old geometry source boundary already identifies this published recutting.
QAS's actual polynomial literal is distinct; no QAS conjugacy or factor is
asserted. No published integrability or figure-based theorem is transferred
to all finite fields.
